newsitem.title: UK: Sears confirms Freemans up for sale - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sears confirms Freemans up for sale - paper.

text.p: UK retailer Sears Plc confirmed on Sunday it was putting its Freemans mail order division up for sale in a bid to raise between 300 and 400 million sterling, the Sunday Telegraph said.
"Freemans is number three in the market. If we cannot make it bigger, we will get out of the sector," the paper quoted Sears chief executive Liam Strong as saying.
"As of yet no offers have been made but if you know someone who wants to buy it, please put them in touch."
Details of the planned divestment leaked into the stock market on Wednesday but a Sears spokesman declined to comment then.
The paper said Sears was hoping to raise between 300 and 400 million stg from a trade buyer.
German mail order giant Otto Versand and British mail order group N Brown have been mooted as possible buyers after institutional pressure for a company shake-up. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
